summary: David Beddingfield was the Democratic nominee for Alabama House District 24 in the 2014 election. He recorded approximately +23.2 OOF CMO against Nathaniel Ledbetter, achieving a positive campaign metric despite facing a resource disadvantage compared to his opponent's roughly $145,000 in contributions versus Beddingfield's about $60,000. His candidacy was supported by education-union backing from the Alabama Education Association (AEA). Prior to and during this election cycle, he served as president of the Fort Payne City Board of Education, a role confirmed by an official 2008 school directory and correspondence in April 2014.
offices_and_public_service: President of the Fort Payne City Board of Education (pre-2014 election)
